title: Teri NDE 2436
content: I was walking underneath a multiple-story building that was being built. They were working on the second floor. As I passed underneath, one of the steel poles used to hold up the walls slipped out of the men's grasps and fell. It smashed me on the head and knocked me unconscious. Those who saw it said my head slammed into the pavement hard as well. As soon as my vision faded to black, I saw these strange beings. They were on a landscape of white and seemed to be made of fire. However, something about them was rougher and scarier than fire. They were screaming as I was falling, a terrible sound, and they were throwing blood everywhere. The blood became an ocean. The fire beings remained until I came to with an oxygen mask pressed over my face. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 6-23-05 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? No. Accident Direct head injury Other unconsciousness How do you consider the content of your experience? Frightening Did you feel separated from your body? Uncertain I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Less consciousness and alertness than normal At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? I wasn't conscious at all during the experience. Were your thoughts speeded up? Neither Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Neither Were your senses more vivid than usual? Neither Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Everything was clearer, and everything looked 2-D and 3-D at the same time. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. There was the screaming sound, which was very clear. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Neither Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? Neither Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes Strange fire beings that were rougher and scarier than fire. They were screaming and throwing blood. Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? Neither Did you see an unearthly light? No Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Unfamiliar, strange place What emotions did you feel during the experience? Fear, denial. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Neither Did you have a feeling of joy? Neither Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? Neither Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? Neither Did scenes from the future come to you? Neither Did you come to a border or point of no return? Neither God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Liberal Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Liberal Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? Definite being, or voice clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see deceased or religious spirits? Neither Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes The beings were just impossible to explain - and the sound they made. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? It was the fire beings scream. I can still hear it. Have you ever shared this experience with others? No Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real I knew it had happened. It was too real to not have happened. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real I still hear the scream and see the fire things. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? It was very creepy and it took me a while to get oriented after I woke up.

arrival.other_being_detail: Strange beings on a white landscape, seeming to be made of fire, described as "rougher and scarier than fire," screaming while throwing blood that became an ocean.

environment.environment_other_detail: Landscape of white; blood became an ocean; vision described as both 2-D and 3-D at the same time.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Hit on the head by a falling steel pole at a construction site; knocked unconscious; oxygen mask used upon awakening.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Vision faded to black, then saw frightening fire beings screaming and throwing blood; no tunnel; awakened with oxygen mask.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Beings described as made of fire but "rougher and scarier than fire"; they screamed and threw blood that became an ocean; vision described as clearer and both 2-D and 3-D simultaneously.
